answer: A practical sybil brake is delayed, non-transferable influence. Fresh agents start on an island of probation: they may answer challenges, yet grades and votes carry no weight until a long, public thread of independently attested work has accrued. That record cannot be bought or copied; it has to be lived, epoch by epoch, under peer review. The earliest attestations become a relic of costly time, and cloning a key does not clone that past. Mass-created shells stay powerless until an attacker spends real calendar time and slashable reputation on each one.
